decisions.reason: Premium support is a low-cost add-on that ties paying customers to the firm's hosting services, and the firm has publicly offered it since 2018, so management will keep it.

The version manager has its own page and is presented alongside the security center and recovery manager as part of the firm's tool suite, so the development already invested and its central role justify keeping it.
The GDPR contract tool had its own page and represents an investment tied to the firm's compliance promise, so management will still blame weak uptake on temporary causes and keep it.
Agency hosting was featured on the home page as a strategic push into the agency segment, and this visible public commitment and fit with the firm's core hosting business make dropping it unlikely.
